bagPolicy.summary: Bags larger than 12x12x12 inches are prohibited at Benchmark International Arena. Large bags must go through an x-ray scanner prior to entry.
bagPolicy.note: Medical and parenting bags exceeding the size limit are permitted but subject to additional search procedures.

parking.note: Parking is available at several garages and lots within a short walking distance to the arena. Payment is card-only, and purchasing parking in advance via ParkWhiz.com is recommended. The Pam Iorio Parking Garage is noted for ADA accessibility.

rideshare.note: Before the event, use the 15-minute drop-off circle just east of Morgan Street and Channelside Drive. Afterward, use a signed Rider Pick Up point at Jefferson and Eunice, Nebraska and Eunice, Nebraska and Cumberland, or Water and Cumberland.

concessions.note: Benchmark International Arena offers a diverse range of food and drink options, including Asian-inspired dishes, classic American comfort foods, and authentic Mexican cuisine. Highlights include the Cigar City Brewing Taproom for craft beers and Corona Cove for tropical-themed eats.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: An accessible drop-off area is in the drop-off circle off Channelside Drive, next to the Accessible Entrance, and guests with disabilities are encouraged to enter via the Florida Ave. entrance. Free wheelchair escorts to your seat are available; ask any arena staff member with a name tag or a Tampa Police officer.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: You can't exit and re-enter during hockey games or events. Once you leave for any reason, you won't be let back in.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: All tickets are mobile only. The ticket office is on the west side of the arena and is open on event days only, starting 3 hours before show time.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: For Tampa Bay Lightning games, doors open 60 minutes before puck drop, and 90 minutes before for premium ticket holders. For other events, doors typically open 60 to 90 minutes before show time. Concerts can differ, so check your event page.
